senses.gloss:
मेथ् (ऋ) मेथृ r. 1st cl. (मेथति-ते)
 1. To understand to comprehend.
 2.
To hurt, to injure.
 3. To kill.
 4. To associate.

मेथि m. (-थिः)
 1. A pillar in the centre of a threshing floor, round which
the cattle turn to tread out the corn.
 2. A prop for supporting
the shafts of a carriage.
 f. (-थी) A sort of grass, (Trigonella
fœnugræcum.)
 E. मथ् to understand, &c. इन् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्;
also with कन् added in the fem. form मेथिका; also मेधि ।
